deviations.what: sap.m.IconTabBar.maxNestingLevel is @since 1.79 - the StepInput of this sample exists to change it, so the property is kept 1:1 and the port needs a UI5 runtime >= 1.79.

onInit adds the 30 IconTabFilters (each with its content Text) in a loop with addItem( ). abap2UI5 has no client-side control factory, so the port binds the items aggregation to a table with the same 30 rows and declares one IconTabFilter template - structural-diff reports both as control extra because the original's view carries only the empty IconTabBar (apps 465-467 precedent).

onMaxNestingLevelChange calls iconTabBar.setMaxNestingLevel(value). The StepInput value and the IconTabBar's maxNestingLevel are the same two-way bound field here, so the StepInput.change attribute is dropped and the property follows without a round-trip.

The shared nesting-level field and the reordering-enabled tab bar are unverified in a running system. **e2e-verified 2026-08-25** (nightly e2e interaction, meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_506.mjs).
